00046 class DelayBaseUGenInternal : public ProxyOwnerUGenInternal
00047 {
00048 public:
00049   DelayBaseUGenInternal(const int numInputs, 
00050               UGen const& input, 
00051               UGen const& delayTime, 
00052               Buffer const& delayBuffer, 
00053               const bool isMultiTap) throw();
00054   UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw() = 0;    // final subclasses now MUST implment this..            
00055   
00056   enum Inputs { Input, DelayTime, NumInputs };
00057   
00058 protected:
00059 
00060   // perhaps move these lookups to Buffer?
00061   inline float lookupIndexN(const int index)
00062   {
00063     return bufferSamples[index];
00064   }
00065   
00066   // must make this more efficient
00067   inline float lookupIndexL(const float fIndex)
00068   {
00069     const int iIndex0 = (int)fIndex;
00070     const int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00071     const float frac = fIndex - (float)iIndex0;
00072     const float value0 = bufferSamples[iIndex0];
00073     float value1;
00074     
00075     if(iIndex1 == delayBuffer_.size()) {
00076       value1 = bufferSamples[0];
00077     } else {  
00078       value1 = bufferSamples[iIndex1];
00079     }
00080     
00081     return value0 + frac * (value1 - value0);
00082   }
00083   
00084   // 0 is one ahead, 1 is this, 2 is on behind, 3 is two behind
00085   //static float cubicinterp(float x, float y0, float y1, float y2, float y3)
00086   inline float lookupIndexC(const float fIndex)
00087   {
00088     const int iIndex1 = (int)fIndex;
00089     const int iIndex0 = iIndex1+1;
00090     const int iIndex2 = iIndex1-1;
00091     const int iIndex3 = iIndex1-2;
00092     const float y0 = bufferSamples[iIndex0];
00093     const float y1 = bufferSamples[iIndex1];
00094     const float y2 = bufferSamples[iIndex2];
00095     const float y3 = bufferSamples[iIndex3];
00096     
00097     const float frac = fIndex - iIndex1;
00098     
00099     // 4-point, 3rd-order Hermite (x-form)
00100     float c0 = y1;
00101     float c1 = 0.5f * (y2 - y0);
00102     float c2 = y0 - 2.5f * y1 + 2.f * y2 - 0.5f * y3;
00103     float c3 = 0.5f * (y3 - y0) + 1.5f * (y1 - y2);
00104     
00105     return ((c3 * frac + c2) * frac + c1) * frac + c0;
00106   }
00107   
00108   Buffer delayBuffer_;
00109   const double delayBufferSize;
00110   float *bufferSamples;
00111   int bufferWritePos;
00112 };

00153 class RecircBaseUGenInternal : public DelayBaseUGenInternal
00154 {
00155 public: 
00156   RecircBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00157                UGen const& delayTime, 
00158                UGen const& decayTime, 
00159                Buffer const& delayBuffer) throw();
00160   
00161   enum Inputs { Input, DelayTime, DecayTime, NumInputs };
00162   
00163 protected:
00164 
00165 #ifndef UGEN_ANDROID
00166   inline float calcFeedback(float delay, float decay)
00167   {
00168     if (delay == 0.f) {
00169       return 0.f;
00170     } else if (decay > 0.f) {
00171       return (float)std::exp(log001 * delay / decay);
00172     } else if (decay < 0.f) {
00173       return (float)-std::exp(log001 * delay / -decay);
00174     } else {
00175       return 0.f;
00176     }
00177   }
00178 #else
00179   //android
00180   inline float calcFeedback(float delay, float decay)
00181   {
00182     if (delay == 0.f) {
00183       return 0.f;
00184     } else if (decay > 0.f) {
00185       return (float)exp(log001 * delay / decay);
00186     } else if (decay < 0.f) {
00187       return (float)-exp(log001 * delay / -decay);
00188     } else {
00189       return 0.f;
00190     }
00191   } 
00192 #endif
00193   
00194   float currentDelay;
00195   float currentDecay;
00196   float feedback;
00197 };

00295 template<class RecircBaseType>
00296 class RecircBaseChain : public UGen
00297 {
00298 public:
00299   
00302   class RecircBaseChainLink : public ChainBankEvent < >
00303   {
00304   public:
00313     RecircBaseChainLink(const float maximumDelayTime = 0.2f, 
00314               ValueArray const& delayTime = 0.2f, 
00315               ValueArray const& decayTime = 0.2f)
00316     : maximumDelayTime_(maximumDelayTime),
00317       delayTime_(delayTime),
00318       decayTime_(decayTime)
00319     {
00320     }
00321     
00326     UGen createEvent(UGen const& input, const int eventCount)
00327     {
00328       return RecircBaseType::AR(input, maximumDelayTime_, delayTime_, decayTime_);
00329     }
00330     
00331   private:
00332     float maximumDelayTime_;
00333     ValueArray const& delayTime_;
00334     ValueArray const& decayTime_;
00335   };
00336   
00347   static UGen AR(UGen const& input, 
00348            const int size,
00349            const float maximumDelayTime = 0.2f, 
00350            ValueArray const& delayTime = 0.2f, 
00351            ValueArray const& decayTime = 0.2f)
00352   {
00353     int numChannels = input.getNumChannels();
00354     if(delayTime.size() > numChannels)
00355       numChannels = delayTime.size();
00356     if(decayTime.size() > numChannels)
00357       numChannels = decayTime.size();
00358       
00359     return Chain<RecircBaseChainLink>::AR(RecircBaseChainLink(maximumDelayTime, 
00360                                   delayTime, 
00361                                   decayTime),
00362                         input, size, numChannels);
00363   }
00364   
00365 private:
00366   RecircBaseChain();
00367 };
